businessGoal: Enable visitors to send messages for support or inquiries

scenarios.goal: Verify that the contact form is accessible on the contact page.
Verify that all required fields are displayed in the contact form.
Verify that the subject dropdown contains all the specified options.
Verify that a validation error is shown when the message is less than 50 characters.
Verify that a confirmation message is displayed upon successful form submission.

clarifications: No scenarios for empty fields or invalid email formats are provided in the acceptance criteria.
